whyGlass.title: Half the taste comes from the bottle
paragraphs: Glass adds nothing of its own. It does not absorb aroma, does not interfere with taste and does not react to heat. Carbonation holds on longer in glass — that sharpness in the first sip stays with you until the last.
Plastic is cheap, easy and fast. We chose the harder way, because we know why the soda you drank as a child tasted so good.
There is one more thing: glass can be recycled endlessly. Insisting on glass also means less waste.

points.title: No aroma loss

points.title: Endlessly recyclable

about.title: Made in Çankırı, bottled in Çankırı
about.body: Çankırı Gazozu is produced in its own factory in the Orta district of Çankırı. Every stage of production, from the water to the bottle, happens here. No contract manufacturing, no production line shipped in from another city — this soda really is Çankırı's.

page.title: The First Factory of Orta OSB
page.lead: At our factory in Orta, Çankırı, soda is still made the way you remember it: in glass bottles, with a traditional recipe, without rushing.

sections.heading: An empty plot, a full dream
sections.body: When the Organised Industrial Zone in Orta, Çankırı was founded, 53 plots were planned across roughly a thousand decares. But what makes an industrial zone real is not the plots — it is the first chimney. That first chimney was ours.

sections.heading: Traditional production, unchanged recipe
sections.body: Our soda has been made with the same recipe since the day we opened. We never left the glass bottle; glass protects carbonation and aroma far better than plastic. Bottles are washed and inspected before filling, and every batch is checked before shipping.

sections.heading: Cornelian cherry soda: a first from Çankırı
sections.body: The cornelian cherry grows in Çankırı's own soil and has become identified with the city. The idea of making soda from this fruit was born here. The natural tartness of the fruit balances the sweetness of the soda, creating a taste unlike any classic fruit soda.

story.title: It Started in a Shop Holding 120 Kinds of Soda
story.lead: Çankırı Gazozu was not born in a marketing meeting. It was born in a shop of about twenty square metres.

sections.heading: The curiosity of a collector
sections.body: When our founder Aybars Şentürk began collecting local sodas from every corner of Türkiye, he was not trying to build a brand. He was curious. Which city produced which soda, where each recipe came from, how old each bottle was. Close to 120 varieties came together in that shop, some of them in bottles seventy years old. Anyone who knew the soda map of Türkiye that closely would eventually ask the same question: so where is Çankırı's soda?

sections.heading: We started with cornelian cherry
sections.body: We found the answer in Çankırı's own soil: the cornelian cherry. In 2019 we produced a soda from it. It was not an easy choice — the fruit is tart, hard to balance and far from a familiar soda aroma. But that is exactly why it was right. We were looking for a taste no other city could copy, and it was already here.

sections.heading: A road not walked alone
sections.body: A brand cannot walk from a shop to a factory on its own. In January 2025, businesspeople Kaptan Mustafa Can and Naci Aydoğan joined the journey — people who had earned their success outside Çankırı and wanted to invest back home. In October 2025 we laid the foundation of the factory in Orta OSB. On 11 July 2026 it officially opened.

sections.heading: What comes next
sections.body: Our goal is not only to sell soda. Çankırı's salted preserves, the pears of Orta, the unheard flavours of this soil — each of them could have a bottle, a package and a brand. We started with soda.

quotes.text: Before we bring a soda in here, I always research its history and its ingredients. I do not bring in a soda I would not drink myself.
quotes.author: Aybars Şentürk

quotes.text: It is not a feeling you can put into words, and not one felt often in Çankırı. Building a brand here and turning it into a factory and a national value is not easy.
quotes.author: Aybars Şentürk

items.question: Where is Çankırı Gazozu produced?
items.answer: In our own factory in the Organised Industrial Zone of Orta, Çankırı. The plant opened in July 2026 and is the first factory of Orta OSB.

items.question: Which flavours are available?
items.answer: Three products are on sale right now: Cornelian Cherry, Classic and Orange. All of them in glass bottles.

items.question: What makes the cornelian cherry soda special?
items.answer: Cornelian cherry is a difficult fruit; its tartness dominates and balancing it takes skill. When we produced this aroma in 2019 there was nothing like it in Türkiye.

items.question: Why do you only use glass bottles?
items.answer: Glass does not absorb aroma or interfere with taste. It holds carbonation longer. It can also be recycled endlessly.

items.question: Where can I buy it?
items.answer: From our dealers, markets and restaurants across our active regions.

privacy.title: Privacy and Cookie Policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains which data is processed when you visit the Çankırı Gazozu website and how that data is protected.

sections.heading: What data do we collect?
sections.body: On this site we only collect data through the dealership application form. The name, company name, city, line of business, phone number, optional email address and message you share in the form are sent to us. There is no membership, ordering or payment on this site.

sections.heading: How do we use it?
sections.body: We use the information you share only to evaluate your dealership application, to contact you and to inform you about your request. This information is not sold or transferred to third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: Who do we share it with?
sections.body: Limited data sharing may take place with the suppliers we work with, such as our email infrastructure provider, so that your application can reach us. Such sharing happens only to deliver the service and only to the extent necessary.

sections.heading: How long do we keep it?
sections.body: Your application is kept throughout the evaluation process and any resulting commercial relationship. If the process does not proceed, records are deleted after a reasonable period. You may request deletion of your record at any time.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Technical data needed for the site to work — such as your language preference and whether the intro video has already been shown in this session — is kept in your browser's own storage and is not sent to us. You can clear this data from your browser settings at any time.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: The information you send through the form is transmitted over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and protected against unauthorised access.

sections.heading: Your rights and contact
sections.body: Details of your rights to access, correct and request deletion of your personal data are set out in the Personal Data Protection Notice. You can reach us through the channels on our contact page.

kvkk.title: Personal Data Protection Notice
kvkk.lead: This notice concerns personal data processed through the dealership application form under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law no. 6698 ("KVKK").

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: Your personal data is processed by Çankırı Gazozu as data controller, within the scope described below. Our contact details are available on the contact page.

sections.heading: Personal data processed
sections.body: Identity data (first name, surname), contact data (phone number, email address, city) and customer transaction data (company name, line of business, the message you send through the form).

sections.heading: Purpose of processing
sections.body: Receiving and evaluating your dealership or distribution application, contacting you, conducting pre-contractual discussions and managing the commercial relationship if one is established.

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: Your data is processed on the basis of Article 5/2-(c) of the KVKK, as directly related to the establishment or performance of a contract, Article 5/2-(f) on our legitimate interest, and the explicit consent you give in the form.

sections.heading: Method of collection
sections.body: Your personal data is collected electronically and automatically when you complete the dealership application form on our website.

sections.heading: Transfers
sections.body: Your data may be shared, on a limited basis, with the email and hosting providers we use so that your application can reach and be stored by us. Where a legal obligation applies, data may be shared with authorised public institutions.

sections.heading: Retention period
sections.body: Your data is retained throughout the evaluation of your application and any ongoing commercial relationship, for the limitation periods set out in the relevant legislation; at the end of that period it is deleted, destroyed or anonymised.

sections.heading: Your rights under Article 11 of the KVKK
sections.body: You have the right to learn whether your personal data is processed, to request information if it has been, to learn the purpose of processing and whether the data is used in line with that purpose, to request correction if it is incomplete or inaccurate, to request erasure or destruction, to request that such actions be notified to third parties to whom the data was transferred, to object to a result against you arising from analysis solely by automated systems, and to claim compensation if you suffer damage due to unlawful processing.

sections.heading: How to apply
sections.body: You can send requests regarding your rights through the channels on our contact page. Your request will be concluded within thirty days at the latest.
